# Enchase

> Library of React 19 and TypeScript components, with CSS Modules, a theme made of `--enchase-*` variables and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility. It needs no router and no global state. npm package: `enchase`.

Install: `npm install enchase`. Entries of the package: `enchase` (components, providers, hooks and types), `enchase/theme` (`createTheme`, `defineStyle`, tokens), `enchase/styles/shadcn` and `enchase/styles/enchase` (the visual styles, data only, one per entry), `enchase/locales` (`en`, `ptBR`), `enchase/icons` (the 19 icons the components use inside), `enchase/styles.css` and `enchase/theme.css`. The package ships `API.md` at `node_modules/enchase/API.md`.

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thiagopedro99/enchase/main/README.md): a short introduction, in English: installation, supported browsers, quick start (Next.js and Vite), a theme from the brand color and what the tests guarantee
- [README.pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thiagopedro99/enchase/main/README.pt-BR.md): the full guide, in Portuguese: navigation without a router and how each `href` is handled, theme and palette from the brand color, motion, customization with CSS, the compact density and server rendering
- [API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thiagopedro99/enchase/main/API.md): props, types, default values and hooks of every component
- [Storybook](https://enchase.othiagosilva.com.br/docs/): interactive demos of every component
